application_review: PROGRESS. The preceding residue-exposure round was rechecked successfully and its authoritative 1333-source manifest was copied before new proof edits. Retained proof sources and exact selected axiom sets remain fixed.

Input translation is an actual multivariable integer polynomial substitution. The degree estimate uses each monomial in the original support, degree bounds for products and powers, and the actual monomial degree bound. Cancellation in an arbitrary polynomial sum is not incorrectly handled by an induction that assumes the original degree equals a sum of degrees.

The concrete subgroup consists of integer-input functions generated by controlled-degree polynomial powers. Mathlib lower-central level zero is the whole original group; degree j+1 therefore corresponds to the paper positive-degree lower-central level. Membership of constants and the actual original affine model arrays is proved. Identification with the full paper Lie polynomial-array group is not asserted.

Nilpotence is proved by actual evaluation homomorphisms: a member of the array lower-central series evaluates into the original model lower-central series at every input. Pointwise equality then forces it to be one. The same argument and a bounded-product lower-central bound cover all jointly stored model factors. Neither commutativity nor finiteness of the integer input space is assumed.

The array input translations are genuine multiplicative equivalences. A shifted generator has the same original group element and a translated polynomial of no larger degree. Closure induction covers products and inverses. This does not prove that the group generated by array values and input automorphisms has the same nilpotence class; the later face-lift and shear construction is still required.

The lattice subgroup uses precisely the requirement that every integer-input evaluation belongs to the original lattice. The original lattice may be nonnormal. Coset evaluation and translation are constructed by quotient lifts with explicit representative compatibility, and their evaluation relation is proved on every coset.

Continuity of coset evaluation refers to the inherited pointwise function topology. No finite-dimensional manifold, lattice discreteness or cocompactness follows from this construction alone. Those claims require identification with the native Lie coefficient array group, bounded coefficient geometry and a genuine lattice argument.

The stored affine model arrays retain their original g, x, signed integer intercept and actual signed progression coefficients. Input shifts change the intercept by the precise dot product. Changing the pivot progression index yields exactly the constant-array left orbit, including negative indices. No convenient substitute observable or commuting original model group is introduced.

Six modules contain 25 theorems and 13 definitions; all 38 declarations are selected for kernel audit. No proof holes, new axioms, structures, global instances, unsafe code or resource settings are introduced. Strict focused checks, full build, kernel checking, exact retained-source and axiom comparisons and final recheck must terminate successfully.

StrongConjecture and the original full finite monochromatic sums/products claim remain unproved. Finite-list native periodic interval inverse existence remains an explicit unproved hypothesis; its genuine existence proof and positive uniform correlation constants must be supplied. Conditional Prediction includes actual admissible parameters, positive finite scale-list closure, common native unit observables and complete fixed-ultrafilter calibration and count limits. Conditional Alignment includes the canonical finite-word schedule, actual execution, positive palette-scale budgets, common positive denominator and certified actual auxiliary visits. Integer realization now proves the actual master pair scale relation, exact natural numerator with its original rational value, canonical bounded full-modulus residues, all required divisibilities, uniform eventual fixed-integer divisibility, finite numerical slot bounds and the numerical own-target array-letter identity. The actual earlier-variable exposure fixes every residue and slot shift, full own-target numerators and array residues; exact affine tail dependence of each progression and the whole own-target progression sum is proved. Concrete integer-input polynomial array groups, their common nilpotence bound, input translations, pointwise lattice coset evaluation and exact affine model linear orbits are constructed. Identification with the paper finite-dimensional native Lie array group, coefficient bounds and topology, discrete cocompact lattice and smooth evaluation remain unproved. HasAlignmentMonomialRecurrence remains an explicit unproved input. Its genuine nilpotent recurrence proof, the actual native polynomial-array model action with its required nilpotence and translation compatibility, microcell boundary and point-law estimates, and positive-probability Alignment bounds remain unproved. Final ordered positive rapidly separated monochromatic extraction is incomplete. No unavoidable blocker is established. A complete public proof repository, official contribution PR, independent review and prize application remain pending; no completed prize submission is claimed.
